## Final Verification Summary

The `index.html` is a **polished, self-contained reaction-time tester** that satisfies every original requirement:

| # | Requirement | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Single offline index.html | ✅ PASS | DOCTYPE, embedded `<style>` + `<script>`, no external imports |
| 2 | Random wait (1.5s–6s) | ✅ PASS | `MIN_WAIT_MS=1500`, `MAX_WAIT_MS=6000`, `Math.random()` delay calculation |
| 3 | False-start detection | ✅ PASS | `handleClick()` checks `state === 'waiting'`, clears timeout, shows "Too early!" error |
| 4 | Five trials | ✅ PASS | `TRAIL_COUNT = 5`, `validTrials.length >= TRAIL_COUNT` triggers results |
| 5 | Results summary (avg/best/worst) | ✅ PASS | `reduce` for avg, `Math.min/max` for best/worst written to DOM |
| 6 | Canvas bar chart | ✅ PASS | `drawChart()` with DPR scaling, gradient bars, value labels, avg line |
| 7 | Millisecond precision | ✅ PASS | `performance.now()` captured on ready, elapsed computed on click |
| 8 | State machine (5 states) | ✅ PASS | `idle→waiting→ready→result→done` transitions all present and correct |
| 9 | Progress dots | ✅ PASS | `.dot/.done/.current` classes managed by `updateDots()` |
| 10 | Responsive CSS + viewport + charset | ✅ PASS | `@media (max-width: 480px)`, viewport meta, charset UTF-8 |
| 11 | Standard deviation | ✅ PASS | Computed via `Math.sqrt` and variance, inserted into results grid |
| 12 | No dead-code | ✅ PASS | Single clean `buildResults()`, no abandoned comments/loops |

**4 unverified behaviors** (all honest): CSS pulse animation timing, touch-end double-tap prevention, canvas pixel rendering, restart dynamic behavior — these require a browser/touch hardware to verify.

**`passed: true`** with **empty `failures` array**. The review.json has been written at `.ralph/review.json`.
limitations: No independent browser/visual testing; earlier browser-origin denial honored. VM/DOM/canvas shims do not establish browser compatibility or visual polish.
Single trial per task and configuration; sampling variance prevents strong causal attribution.
